name: hcloudplus
description: A Pulumi provider for Hetzner Cloud's undocumented console API. Manages projects, mints project API tokens, invites members, and reads cross-project audit logs — everything the official hcloud Pulumi/Terraform provider can't reach. Built on terraform-provider-hcloudplus.
attribution: This Pulumi package is based on the [`hcloudplus` Terraform Provider](https://github.com/hatemosphere/terraform-provider-hcloudplus).

endpoint.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1. Useful for recording/replay or tests.

password.description: Hetzner Cloud Console password. Required when userToken is not set. Can also be set via HCLOUDPLUS_PASSWORD.

totpCmd.description: Shell command whose stdout (trimmed) is the current 6-digit TOTP code. Example: "op read 'op://vault/accounts.hetzner.com/one-time password?attribute=totp'". Required when userToken is not set. Can also be set via HCLOUDPLUS_TOTP_CMD.

userToken.description: Account-level user token extracted from a logged-in Hetzner Cloud Console session. Mutually exclusive with username/password/totp_cmd. Can also be set via the HCLOUDPLUS_USER_TOKEN environment variable.

username.description: Hetzner Cloud Console username (robot login / client number or account email). Required when userToken is not set. Can also be set via HCLOUDPLUS_USERNAME.

email.description: Primary email address on the owning Hetzner account.

id.description: Numeric Hetzner account ID of the project owner.

robotCn.description: Hetzner Robot client number (e.g. K0247406420) of the owning account.

accepted.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation was accepted, or empty if still pending.

created.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation was sent.

email.description: Email address of the invitee. Hetzner accepts any syntactically valid email; it does not validate deliverability.

expired.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation expired (Hetzner times invitations out after some period), or empty if still valid. A non-empty value on refresh means the invite can no longer be accepted by the recipient. Combine with `pulumi up -replace` or the `reinviteOnExpiry` attribute to mint a fresh invitation.

projectId.description: ID of the project to invite the user into, as a string (e.g. `hcloudplus_project.x.id`).

reinviteOnExpiry.description: If true, Read will check whether the invitation has expired; if so, the resource is marked for replacement on the next plan (a fresh invitation is created and the stale one is revoked). Defaults to false. This is the only way to get automatic re-invitation without a manual `-replace`.

role.description: Role to grant on acceptance. One of: admin, member, restricted.
